source.citation: Seton, M., Müller, R. D., Zahirovic, S., Williams, S., Wright, N., Cannon, J., Whittaker, J., Matthews, K., McGirr, R. (2020). A global dataset of present-day oceanic crustal age and seafloor spreading parameters. Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 21, e2020GC009214. doi:10.1029/2020GC009214
source.knownArtefacts: Gridding artefacts around microplates (e.g. Bauer), along fracture zones (e.g. central Atlantic) and where spreading is highly oblique (e.g. SW Indian Ridge) — the release README.

grid.encoding: uint16 ages / quantum; zig-zag delta along each row, reset at every no-crust node and at each row start; byte-shuffled (all high bytes, then all low bytes); gzip
